LanguageData.RLI_LearningNotice: Reading and conversations improve each pawn's knowledge. Prisoner interactions and trade depend on the acting pawn; social factors depend on knowledge shared by both pawns.
LanguageData.RLI_PrisonerLanguageRequired: The warden must master the prisoner's native language.
LanguageData.RLI_Unassigned: Native language pending: no language assigned to the original faction, or world configuration is not complete.
LanguageData.RLI_Unavailable: This language no longer exists in the current configuration. Knowledge is retained without reassignment.
LanguageData.RLI_DevEditDesc: Set this pawn's language or dialect level with the developer adjustment panel.
LanguageData.RLI_DevLanguageRule: Confirming a level below 100% resets this language's dialects to 0%. Native markers are retained. Only this pawn's levels change.
LanguageData.RLI_DevDialectRule: Confirming a dialect above 0% sets its language to 100%. Other dialects and native markers are retained. Only this pawn's levels change.
LanguageData.RLI_TradeLanguageRequired: The negotiator must master this faction's language.
LanguageData.RLI_DevSocialSecond: Click the second pawn to compare with {0}
LanguageData.RLI_DevAddPawn: Click the pawn who will receive this knowledge
LanguageData.RLI_DevAddTitle: Add to {0} — 100% mastery (dialect: parent language too)
LanguageData.RLI_DevAddNone: {0} already masters every available language and dialect.
LanguageData.RLI_DevGenerationTitle: Inspect quest and trader visit filters
LanguageData.RLI_TransmissionDescription: After successful chitchat or deep talk, pawns can transmit a language or dialect mastered at 100%. Social must be enabled for both pawns; their abilities influence speed. Babies also learn while being fed or playing with an adult; only the adult needs enabled Social. Adjust learning difficulty in Cybranian — Rim Languages settings. This checkbox only controls automatic transmission; it does not change interaction frequency, reading or the prisoner language learning order.
LanguageData.RLI_FactionIndividualLevels: Knowledge levels belong to each pawn. See their Languages tab.
